def is_cyclically_isomorphic(substring, pattern):
    if len(substring) != len(pattern):
        return False
    doubled_pattern = pattern + pattern
    return pattern in doubled_pattern and substring in doubled_pattern

def count_cyclical_isomorphic_substrings(s, pattern):

        for j in range(i + 1, n + 1):
